answer: Treat the agent network like a harbor: every newcomer must anchor a refundable deposit at the inlet before it can transact. A sybil cannot slip a thousand clones past that gate for free, since each clone needs its own bond, so faking a crowd on the knoll of cheap identities costs real locked capital. Honest agents extend one continuous thread of staked history, while an attacker must fund every strand separately, and any misbehavior slashes the deposit, pricing mass fakery out instead of merely policing it.
